title: Le master produit
intro: Une photo studio de référence par marque. Toutes les déclinaisons partiront d'elle.

jobs.label: Master produit
jobs.prompt:
Reference images: the first three show the product construction; the LAST image is the brand logo to embroider on the round patch.

PRODUCT (reproduce exactly the construction of the reference product photos): a surfboard carry sling. A flat rectangular panel of heavy cotton canvas about 60 x 48 cm, fully lined, with a flat patch pocket on the front, and two long flat cotton webbing straps sewn down the panel that meet above it. The panel wraps around the middle of a longboard: the board passes through the loop, the upper part of the panel shows over the board, the straps rise above. Fine topstitching, bar-tacks at the strap joins. A small round embroidered patch sewn on the front pocket reproduces the attached logo artwork in thread.

COLORWAY: panel in mandarine-orange canvas #F26A2E, straps in pistachio-green webbing #B5D99C, patch on cream with the A-sling logo.

Studio packshot for an e-commerce product page: the sling mounted on a plain white longboard lying horizontally, shot three-quarter from slightly above, soft window light from the left, gentle realistic shadow, seamless background in warm cream #FBF7EF. The canvas weave, the stitching, the embroidery threads and the webbing texture are razor sharp. Real product photography, no CGI look, no text, no extra logos, vertical 4:5.
